execution: Read-only review of actual source, test cases, reported hashes and existing logs. No tests/build/discovery/browser executed by reviewer.

closure.evidence: validate_handoff pins approved manifest SHA, enforces exact five-role set/path/hash, current-role source_kind and Go hash, and exact current Go/mod/sum file hashes. Runs before any tests/build. Main regression rejects swapped binary and changed source before run_command.

finalize_manifest collects each final field best-effort, records unknown/error and failed status without replacing existing failure, and writes complete not_completed_suites via atomic replacement. Popen is inside try; process finally records launch failure. Main regression deletes binary then fails final source inventory and verifies original failure retained. Final dependency drift also changes status and return code to nonzero.

run_command handles BaseException after launch, attempts bounded owned-tree cleanup for nonterminal parent, falls back to parent.kill and15s wait, preserves original exception and explicitly leaves descendant termination unproven. Regression injects KeyboardInterrupt plus tree-kill error and unresolved wait.

dependency_integrity.contract: Installed web node_modules and resolved global npm: full byte hashes before/finally, full path/size/mtime each stage; Node executable/npm entry hash each stage; only top-level .tmp/.vite excluded. Not continuous byte monitoring or tamper-proof attestation.
dependency_integrity.regression: Actual temporary dependency content changed with same size/mtime; metadata deliberately remains equal while final byte check rejects passed status.
dependency_integrity.limits: Initial and final hashes cannot prove absence of transient content modification that is later restored. Excluded generated caches are outside package-byte guarantee. This follows the parent-approved bounded monitoring contract, not broader full continuous immutability.

retained_acceptance_contracts: 145-ID actual discovery still required; no existing results substituted.
SUB03 prerequisite2 separate from denominator; exact recovery six groups of7 and exact42 disjoint union.
Each accepted result exactly one pass/retry0/no skip/flaky/unexpected.

limitations: No claim that build, discovery, SUB03 or145 cases have passed.
Failure to write evidence due to unavailable output storage cannot be guaranteed away by atomic replacement; this is not crash-durable fsync journaling.
Cleanup reports parent outcome and descendant uncertainty, not proof all descendants stopped.
Original COMMIT long-tail incidents and voice/Pilot application readiness remain separate.
